description: A precision-crafted bow forged from tempered metal plates and bound with treated leather. Instead of relying on the natural flex of wood, its limbs are reinforced with arcane-conductive alloys that channel energy through embedded gemstones. Each shot resonates with stored power, releasing arrows with engineered accuracy and a faint crackle of magic. Though heavier and less flexible than traditional bows, its calibrated tension and gem-stabilizers grant it a rare chance to strike at the perfect moment.
name: Arcane Engineer's Bow
